title: High-risk customers who opened an account in 2025
prompt: How many customers in the 'high' risk segment opened an account in 2025?
population: High-risk-segment customers, joined to accounts opened in 2025.
metricDefinition: count of distinct high-risk customers who opened an account in 2025.
transformationPlan: join to accounts, filter to opened_at in 2025
referenceSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.risk_segment = 'high' AND a.opened_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.opened_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
